title: The AITHYRA International PhD Call in AI for Biomedicine (all genders)
about: AITHYRA invites applications to its International PhD Program in AI for Biomedicine in Vienna, run with TU Wien, Uni Wien and MedUni Wien. The program starts on 1 September 2027; the application window runs from 1 September to 1 November 2026.
requirements: Master's degree in a relevant field, or expected by September 2027
